title: kstack lock
description: Pins vendored skill packages and the skill directory names each package owns. First-party folders not named here are never overwritten by kstack sync/update.

source.description: Same string you would pass to `npx skills add <source>` (usually owner/repo).

pin.description: Git commit SHA (or equivalent). Empty means not yet materialized; run `kstack update <id>`.

skills.description: Skill directory names this package owns. Sync/update may write only these folders.

hashes.description: sha256 of each owned skill's SKILL.md after the last successful write.

fetchedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last successful sync/update/add write.
